title: Chapter 451 - 451 Play; Arrival (2)

Chapter 451 - 451 Play; Arrival (2)

Chapter 451 - 451 Play; Arrival (2)

451 Play; Arrival (2)

“When did you wake up?” Qin Yuxuan asked happily.

“Just now,” Lin Fan said.

Pausing, Lin Fan continued, “You must be tired during this period of time.”

Qin Yuxuan said, “It doesn’t matter if I’m tired… Most importantly, I feel very fulfilled. I’m very satisfied to see the projects grow.”

As she said this, her beautiful eyes seemed to flicker.

Obviously, she really enjoyed it.

Lin Fan stroked Qin Yuxuan’s hair gently, his heart aching for her.

At this moment, the doorbell rang.

“Your breakfast is here.”

Lin Fan opened the door slowly.

A waiter pushed a small cart in and served exquisite breakfast to the table.

Then, he respectfully said, “Please enjoy.”

Hence, Lin Fan and Qin Yuxuan sat together and tasted the delicacies.

Eating with the person he loved seemed to make his appetite especially good.

Soon, they finished all the food.

Lin Fan and Qin Yuxuan’s faces were filled with satisfaction. Then, the two of them leaned against each other, looking very blissful and sweet.

…

At this moment, at Modu International Airport.

Audis and Jeeps lined up neatly at the airport, forming a sqaure.

The black mass of people looked up at the sky, their eyes filled with anticipation.

“Rumble!”

The next moment, a luxury plane landed.

A white-haired old man slowly walked out of the plane under everyone’s gaze.

A man in a white shirt quickly went up to him and said happily, “Mr. Ye, welcome to Modu.”

Ye Xiu looked at the scene in front of him with a nostalgic expression.

After a while, he said in a slightly hoarse voice, “This is thoughtful… However, I have some important matters to deal with later, so I can’t invite everyone to a banquet for the time being to express my gratitude…

“Cough, cough, cough!”

Ye Xiu’s body was not in good condition.

Now, after a bumpy night on the plane, he looked even weaker.

After coughing for a while, he turned his gaze to the four great families.

“Where’s Mr. Lin?”

Although it was just a simple question, it made everyone from the four great families extremely excited.

Elder Ye!

They had met Elder Ye!

Moreover, Elder Ye even spoke to him!

“Mr. Lin should be at the Shangri-La Hotel,” the Wang family’s patriarch said respectfully. “I’ll invite him over now.”

“No need, I’ll go personally to see Mr. Lin!””

After saying that, he got into the car that bore a red flag in front of him and sped away.

The people from the four families did not dare to hesitate at all. They also got into their own cars and followed closely behind.

As for the man in white and the others, they stood where they were and silently watched the shadow of the car with the red flag leave. They pondered for a while.

Elder Ye wanted to visit Mr. Lin personally.

Who was this Mr. Lin?

“Leader, should we follow them?” asked the middle-aged man beside the man in the white shirt.

The man in the white shirt shook his head. “If we follow him without permission, we’ll make him unhappy.”

“Then… should we investigate Mr. Lin?” the middle-aged man said.

The man in the white shirt thought for a moment and said, “I’m afraid this is not something we can decide. Let’s report it to the capital.”

He was definitely not joking.

He had a certain understanding of Ye Xiu.

He was the current leader of the Qing Hong Sect!

How high was his status?

What kind of status would Mr. Lin, whom Elder Ye wanted to personally visit, have?

Then, the man in the white shirt thought of Ye Xiu’s old face and how he had coughed up blood. “Elder Ye’s health must also be reported. I hope nothing happens to him.”

…

Ye Xiu’s team faced no obstructions on the road.

A moment later, they arrived at the lobby of the Shangri-La Hotel.

However, Ye Xiu did not go directly to the presidential suite where Lin Fan was. He took a few deep breaths and said, “Lil Wang, call Mr. Lin and ask if I can go up and visit him.”

When the people from the four families heard this, they were shocked.

Ye Xiu coming to Modu personally just to see Lin Fan had already shocked them.

Just now, he took the initiative to come to the Shangri-La Hotel, which surprised them again.

Now… they were about to meet Lin Fan, but Ye Xiu actually wanted to ask for permission!

This…

To think that Lin Fan held such a high position in Ye Xiu’s heart!

The four great families were shocked and terrified.

They started to think about whether or not they had neglected Lin Fan in the past two days.

Then, they thought of Liu Kaijun, who had offended Lin Fan yesterday.

Yesterday, they felt that letting the Liu family live on the streets was already a severe punishment.

From the looks of it now, it might not be enough!

The middle-aged man beside Ye Xiu, Ye Feng, could not help but open his mouth when he heard Ye Xiu’s words. “Old Master, you…”

However, before he could finish speaking, Ye Xiu’s sharp eyes swept over him, scaring Ye Feng into shutting his mouth.

…

At this moment, Lin Fan and Qin Yuxuan were snuggling together, enjoying their sweet time.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

He looked at the caller ID. It was the patriarch of the Wang family, one of the four great families in Modu.

Lin Fan did not hesitate and answered the call.

“Hello, Mr. Lin,” the patriarch said respectfully.

Lin Fan said, “Hello. Is anything the matter?”

The other party was an old man, so he should also give the other party some respect.

The patriarch of the Wang family said, “Elder Ye is already in the lobby of the Shangri-La Hotel. He asked me to ask if he could go up and meet you.”

Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, “Alright, he can come up.”

Yesterday, the people from the four families told Lin Fan that Ye Xiu might come back from America to see him.

He was already so old, yet he specially came from the other half of the world to ask for instructions…

It could be said that the man was showing the utmost courtesy.

Under such circumstances, if Lin Fan was not even willing to meet him…

That would be too unreasonable of him.

Ye Xiu was very happy that Lin Fan agreed to let him go up. When he reached the door of the presidential suite, he tidied his clothes before pressing the doorbell.

“Please come in,” Lin Fan said.

Ye Xiu pushed open the door and slowly walked in. The people from the four families continued to wait outside like servants.

After Ye Xiu walked into the suite, his turbid gaze landed on Lin Fan and the dragon ring in his hand. He was extremely excited.

Then, he bowed 90 degrees and said respectfully, “Ye Xiu from the Qing Hong Sect greets the sect master!”

Sect master?

That was right! Lin Fan was the sect master!

Lin Fan was the heir of the Qing Hong Sect’s founder, and he had the dragon ring. If he was not the sect master, then what was he?

Even though Lin Fan knew that Ye Xiu was an old man, after seeing his appearance, he could not help but be surprised.

One had to know…

Lin Fan had Sun Simiao’s Medical Experience.

With his traditional medicine skills, he could tell that Ye Xiu was definitely over a hundred years old.

It was tough for an old man like him to travel thousands of kilometers and rush to Modu overnight just to pay his respects.

Moreover, he had lung cancer, heart disease, diabetes, and many other illnesses.

If he was careless, he could very well die during the journey.

“Cough, cough, cough!”

Perhaps it was because he was too excited to see Lin Fan or perhaps it was because he had traveled a long distance, Ye Xiu suddenly coughed violently.

Qin Yuxuan, who was standing at the side, cried out in fear, “Old man, what’s wrong? Why are you coughing up blood?!”

When Ye Feng and the people from the four families who had been waiting outside heard these voices, they could no longer wait outside. They could not help but push open the door and barge in.

Even though Ye Xiu was seriously ill and fell into a coughing fit, he only wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth. When he recovered, he turned around and shouted, “Bastards, who let you in?!

“Cough, cough, cough!”

After saying that, he coughed again.
